provenance.source: C. M. Andolina et al., Computational Materials Science 209, 111384 (2022), DOI: 10.1016/j.commatsci.2022.111384
provenance.source_values: Single-T solution energy -0.429 eV/H; TTn1 solution energy about -0.25 eV/H at about 1.30 angstrom; TTn2 is about 0.02 eV/H more stable than isolated T at 2.28 angstrom.
provenance.projection: Pair energies are inferred as twice the per-H solution-energy difference relative to isolated T: +0.358 eV for TTn1 and -0.042 eV for TTn2.
provenance.limitations: This two-shell pair projection omits the non-pairwise relaxation visible in the reported 3H and 4H structures and has not been fit as a converged cluster expansion.
